in_sanskrit.name: विधि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who instructs or follows Dharma, Vidhi or Karma. The rule or procedure of doing things.

in_hindi.name: विधि
in_hindi.long_meaning: Vidhi is a name that means rule, procedure, or law in Hinduism. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vidhana', which means 'to lay down a rule or procedure'. In Hindu mythology, Vidhi is also the name of a goddess who personifies the law or procedure.

in_tamil.name: விதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Vidhi is a name that is derived from the Tamil words 'vidi' which means 'knowledge' and 'attiyar' which means 'one who instructs'. It is also associated with the goddess Vidhya, who is the goddess of knowledge and learning.

in_telugu.name: విధి
in_telugu.long_meaning: Vidhi is a name that means 'law' or 'procedure' in Telugu. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vidhana', which means 'to lay down a rule or procedure'. In Hindu mythology, Vidhi is also the name of a goddess who personifies the law or procedure.

in_marathi.name: Vidhi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Law, rule, knowledge, wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vidhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vidhi is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the root word 'vidh' which means 'to know, to learn, to understand, to instruct'. The name Vidhi signifies law, rule, knowledge, wisdom, and justice. In Hindu mythology, Vidhi is the name of the goddess of law, order, and justice, who is often invoked before making any important decisions or taking any significant actions.
